recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結切片中，被膜下與竇狀隙、副皮質區被大片淡粉紅色、胞質豐富的細胞浸潤，只殘留幾個深藍色的淋巴濾泡，這種以竇為主的淡染組織細胞擴張提示蘭格罕細胞組織球增生症（LCH）侵犯淋巴結。
features: Lymph node architecture partially effaced at low power
Subcapsular and intranodal sinuses/paracortex expanded by sheets of pale eosinophilic cells with abundant cytoplasm
Residual dark-staining lymphoid follicles and cords of small lymphocytes between the pale areas
Intact thin fibrous capsule at the top of the field
Individual nuclear grooves and eosinophils not resolvable at this magnification
describe_en: Section of lymph node at low power shows partial effacement of the architecture by pale-staining infiltrates that distend the subcapsular and medullary sinuses and extend into the paracortex. Residual lymphoid follicles and bands of small lymphocytes remain between the pale sheets. Cytologic detail (nuclear grooves, eosinophils, necrosis) cannot be assessed at this magnification. The sinus-based histiocytic pattern is suggestive of nodal involvement by Langerhans cell histiocytosis; confirmation requires high-power morphology and CD1a/langerin (CD207) and S100 immunostains.

ddx.vs: Reactive sinus histiocytes lack grooved, folded nuclei and eosinophil-rich infiltrates and are CD1a and langerin negative.
Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes are very large with emperipolesis and are S100 positive but CD1a and langerin negative.
Dermatopathic change expands the paracortex with a nodular mix of Langerhans cells, interdigitating cells and melanin-laden macrophages rather than filling sinuses with sheets of Langerhans cells.
Hodgkin lymphoma contains CD30/CD15-positive Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed background rather than sheets of CD1a-positive histiocytes.
